text: Heavy flooding has covered the main road near the city center. Water levels are rising rapidly and several vehicles are stuck. Residents are requesting immediate rescue assistance.
Wildfire spreading in the forest area near residential zones. Evacuation orders have been issued for three neighborhoods. Fire departments from multiple counties are responding.

Strong earthquake felt across the metropolitan area at 14:32 local time. Buildings swayed for approximately 30 seconds. No immediate reports of major damage but people evacuated offices as precaution.
Major landslide blocked the highway connecting the valley to the main city. Several trucks and cars are trapped. Debris covers approximately 200 meters of road. Rescue teams en route.
Partial building collapse reported in the old market district. Three-story commercial building collapsed during renovation work. Emergency services on scene searching for workers who may be trapped.
